input.title: Migrate docs site off legacy static generator
input.description:
Track the migration of the docs site from the old static generator to the new one.

**Repo:** acme-labs/docs-site
**Roadmap:** Notion "Docs Roadmap" (https://www.notion.so/9e7a3c154d824b60a1f36c0d8e2b5f94)

## Scope / checklist
- [ ] Choose target generator and document the decision
- [ ] Inventory existing pages, content, templates, plugins, and build scripts
- [ ] Set up the new generator in docs-site and confirm local build
- [ ] Port content and templates; fix internal links and asset paths
- [ ] Migrate navigation, search, and redirects for old URLs
- [ ] Set up CI build and preview deployments
- [ ] Compare old vs. new output (content and links) before cutover
- [ ] Cut over DNS/hosting and monitor
- [ ] Decommission the old generator and its config

## Notes
- The docs site currently runs on the old static generator.

input.title: Login bug: users get logged out after 5 minutes
input.description:
## Summary
Users are being logged out approximately 5 minutes after logging in.

## Suspected area
Login/session code in the **acme-labs/auth-service** repository.

## Expected behavior
Users remain logged in for the configured session duration.

## Actual behavior
Users are logged out after about 5 minutes.

## Next steps
- Reproduce the issue and confirm the session/token expiry configuration in auth-service.
- Check token refresh handling and cookie/session TTL settings.
- Confirm whether the issue affects all clients or only specific platforms.

input.title: Login bug: users are logged out after 5 minutes
input.description:
## Summary
Users are being logged out approximately 5 minutes after logging in.

## Expected behavior
Sessions remain valid for the configured session duration and users stay logged in.

## Actual behavior
Users are logged out after about 5 minutes.

## Likely location
Login/session code is owned by the `auth-service` repo (GitHub: acme-labs/auth-service). Check session/token expiry and refresh handling there.

## Next steps
- Reproduce and confirm the exact timeout (session cookie max-age, JWT/access token expiry, or refresh token behavior)
- Identify whether the 5-minute window comes from config or code
- Fix and verify sessions persist past 5 minutes

input.title: Users are logged out after 5 minutes
input.description:
## Summary
Users are being logged out of the app approximately 5 minutes after logging in.

## Expected behavior
Sessions should persist for the configured session duration and not expire after ~5 minutes.

## Actual behavior
Users are logged out roughly 5 minutes after login.

## Likely area
Login/session code in the `acme-labs/auth-service` repository (session expiry / token TTL / refresh handling).

## Next steps
- Confirm the session/token TTL configured in auth-service and compare to the observed ~5 minute timeout.
- Check whether refresh tokens are issued and used correctly.
- Reproduce and add a regression test.
